lines.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

data.define: Used to add a new, related thought in a talk.

example.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

misuse.text: Don't use 'by the way' for your main point.
misuse.why: It signals a minor, extra comment.

data.l1_hook: Ah, "by the way", tem mais uma coisa!
data.l1_ex: "By the way", a festa começa às sete.
